- **Intercepteur ou Contre-ogives ?** L'« Intercepteur » est le premier vaisseau de combat. Les « Contre-ogives » sont les missiles qui abattent les Ogives longue portée ; elles s'appelaient « Intercepteurs » avant le 15/11/2026.

en/getting-started/glossary: | Interception Missile (game: Interceptors) | Intercepteurs | Interceptores | interceptors |
- **Interceptor or Interception Missile?** The Interceptor is the first combat ship. The Interception Missile (shown as "Interceptors" in the game) is the missile that destroys Long-Range Warheads.

- **Interceptor or Anti-Ballistic Missiles?** The Interceptor is the first combat ship. Anti-Ballistic Missiles are the missiles that shoot down Long-Range Warheads; the game called them "Interceptors" until 15/11/2026.
en/defense/missiles: - **"Anti-Ballistic Missile" is not the "Interceptor"**: the missile and the combat ship have nothing in common. The game shows the missile as "Interceptors".
- **Anti-Ballistic Missiles are not the Interceptor**: the missile and the combat ship have nothing in common. The game called these missiles "Interceptors" until 15/11/2026.
